answer: At enrollment, a carrier issues a one-use locker nonce for a parcel placed in a public locker; the claimant must retrieve it after a randomly chosen 24–72-hour delay, with both scans signed to the same parcel serial. The registry consumes the serial only after delayed pickup and rejects mismatched or reused scans. Proposed locker and verification fee is .40, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .40 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,400 (1,000 × .40). Bind the nonce to dawn/grove/tide. Limitation: colluding carriers can forge scans, and lockers are unevenly accessible.
